result.instructions: Tools for Namely, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who reports to Jane Smith, and what are their job titles?"; "List everyone in the Sales department with their start dates."; "Which employees have a work anniversary or birthday coming up?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Namely data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run namely_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run namely_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run namely_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. namely_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: namely_get_me
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Get the profile of the user the connected token belongs to (name, email, job title, manager, access role). Namely API: GET /profiles/me.

tools.name: namely_list_profiles
tools.title: List employee profiles
tools.description: List employee profiles (active, pending and inactive unless filtered) with paging, sorting and filters. Returns {profiles, meta:{count}, linked}. Use format=short for a smaller record (ids, names, email, status, job title); the full record includes every custom field the token may see (compensation, addresses and other sensitive HR data). An empty page means the end. Namely API: GET /profiles (limit 100 requests per minute).

format.description: short = truncated profile objects (default); full = every field.

sort.description: Sort order; a leading - reverses it.

job_title.description: Exact job title (the `title` of a job title).

reports_to.description: Profile id of a manager: only that person's direct reports.

tools.name: namely_get_profile
tools.title: Get employee profile
tools.description: Get one employee's full profile by id: personal and job data, manager, groups, teams and the custom fields the token may see (can include compensation and other sensitive HR data). Namely API: GET /profiles/{id}.

id.description: Namely profile id (the `id` of a profile from namely_list_profiles).

tools.name: namely_list_profile_fields
tools.title: List profile fields
tools.description: List the fields of the employee profile as configured at this company (standard and custom), with their labels, sections and the valid format of each value. Namely API: GET /profiles/fields.

tools.name: namely_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List all groups (departments, office locations and other company groups). Every group belongs to one group type. Namely API: GET /groups.

tools.name: namely_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: Get one group by id, with the profiles (members) linked to it. Namely API: GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: namely_list_group_types
tools.title: List group types
tools.description: List the group types (the containers of groups, such as Department or Office). Namely API: GET /group_types.

tools.name: namely_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List all teams with their team categories. Namely API: GET /teams.

tools.name: namely_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get one team by id, with the profiles (members) linked to it. Namely API: GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: namely_list_job_titles
tools.title: List job titles
tools.description: List all job titles; each belongs to one job tier. Namely API: GET /job_titles.

tools.name: namely_list_job_tiers
tools.title: List job tiers
tools.description: List all job tiers (the levels that group job titles). Namely API: GET /job_tiers.

tools.name: namely_list_events
tools.title: List feed events
tools.description: List events of the company home feed (announcements, birthdays, work anniversaries, new arrivals), newest first by default, with limit and after (an event id) for paging. Namely API: GET /events.

type.description: Event type, e.g. birthday, announcement, recent_arrival, anniversary.

profile_id.description: Only events associated with this profile id.

after.description: Event id after which to start (for the next page).

tools.name: namely_list_event_comments
tools.title: List event comments
tools.description: List the comments on a feed event. Namely API: GET /events/{event-id}/comments.

tools.name: namely_get_report
tools.title: Get report
tools.description: Run a saved Namely report by id and return its columns and rows (live data; each row is a list in column order). Find the id in the URL of the report in Namely. Reports can contain sensitive HR data such as salary history. Namely API: GET /reports/{id}.

tools.name: namely_update_profile
tools.title: Update employee profile
tools.description: Change standard fields of an employee profile (name, emails, start date, status, manager, job title). WRITES live HR data. Send only the fields to change. Setting user_status to pending needs a personal_email. Namely API: PUT /profiles/{id}.

id.description: Namely profile id (the `id` of a profile from namely_list_profiles).

personal_email.description: Personal email (required when user_status is pending).

reports_to.description: Profile id of the new manager.

job_title.description: New job title: an object with the id or the exact title of an existing job title.

tools.name: namely_create_announcement
tools.title: Post announcement
tools.description: Post an announcement to the company home feed, visible to every employee. Markdown; to mention a person write [Full Name](/people/<profile_id>). With is_appreciation, mentioned people are appreciated. email_all=true ALSO EMAILS every active employee at their company address (needs the permission) and cannot be undone: set it only when the user explicitly asks. Namely API: POST /events.

is_appreciation.description: If true, mentioned profiles are appreciated.

email_all.description: If true, also emails all active employees. Default false.

tools.name: namely_create_event_comment
tools.title: Comment on event
tools.description: Add a comment to a feed event, posted as the token's user and visible to employees who see the event. Markdown; mention a person with [Full Name](/people/<profile_id>). Namely API: POST /events/{id}/comments.

prompts.title: Get started with Namely
